newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK TO TRADE WITH NO PRICE LIMIT - BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK TO TRADE WITH NO PRICE LIMIT - BOURSE.

text.p: Shares of recently listed Xiosbank will trade with no daily volatility limit on Thursday, the Athens bourse said in a statement.
Xiosbank shares will start trading in regular session, eschewing the staging session.
The staging session lasts from 1030 local (0730 GMT) through 1045 local (0745 GMT). It is followed by the regular session which ends at 1330 local (1030 GMT).
Xiosbank shares traded with a 20 percent limit on Tuesday following overwhelming buy interest on Monday which resulted in a break down in the bourse's electronic trading system.
On Wednesday, the price volatility limit was removed and its shares nearly doubled to 6,328 drachmas in active trading.
There was open buy interest for some 83,000 shares at close because the automated trading system is not designed to accommodate triple-digit price changes.
Xiosbank shares will start trading with the bourse's typical 8.0 percent daily volatility limit effective May 30. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
